:::{#sol-rank-factorization-construct-practice}

[Columns 1 and 2 of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column), $(1, 2, 1)$ and $(2, 4, 0)$,
are [linearly independent](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-linearly-independent):
the third entry of $c_1\,(1, 2, 1) + c_2\,(2, 4, 0)$ is $c_1$, and then the first is $2 c_2$.
They [span](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-span) $\mathcal{C}(\matr{A})$,
since the third column equals the first plus the second,
so $\rankf{\matr{A}} = 2$.
Each column of $\matr{A}$ in terms of them:

$$
\ba
(1, 2, 1) &= 1 \cd (1, 2, 1) + 0 \cd (2, 4, 0),
\\
(2, 4, 0) &= 0 \cd (1, 2, 1) + 1 \cd (2, 4, 0),
\\
(3, 6, 1) &= 1 \cd (1, 2, 1) + 1 \cd (2, 4, 0).
\ea
$$

So

$$
\matr{C} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 0},
\qquad
\matr{R} = \sbmat{1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1},
$$

and multiplying gives back $\matr{A}$.

:::
